themes.title: Transnational Recalibration Following MAGA Midterm Defeats
themes.blurb: Following the Republican defeat in the U.S. midterm elections, right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and Latin America are assessing the fallout on their own domestic prospects or publicly distancing themselves from Donald Trump. From Nigel Farage facing media backlash over his Trump alignment to factional debates within Germany's AfD and strategic pivots in Italy and Argentina, the U.S. vote has triggered a broad conservative recalibration.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Reels from midterm defeat as administration figures like JD Vance blame the Iran war while Trump elevates hardliner Stephen Miller.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage comes under pressure over his Trump ties, publicly criticizing Trump's foreign policy as a 'broken promise'.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni balances preserving U.S. relations while insulating her government and pivoting closer to European allies after the Republican defeat.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's administration confronts market uncertainty and media fallout assessing how Trump's loss impacts Latin American right-wing momentum.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: The GOP midterm loss sparks an internal AfD factional debate regarding the party's foreign policy alignment with Trumpism.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French analysts and party figures gauge whether Trump's setback signals broader electoral limits for populist movements ahead of 2027.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in multiple nations face mounting state scrutiny, legal proceedings, and security breaches. German officials are evaluating ban procedures against the AfD following massive email leaks, Brazil's electoral court opens new investigations into Flávio Bolsonaro, and Italian authorities investigate dark web leaks targeting top cabinet ministers.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Electoral authorities launch three new investigations against Flávio Bolsonaro while he resides in the US to avoid domestic prosecution.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni accuses pro-Russian hackers of publishing Foreign Minister Tajani's personal data on the dark web.

themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Far-right and populist conservative movements are altering tactics and expanding campaign efforts ahead of impending national and regional elections. Sweden's Sweden Democrats dropped their cabinet mandate to facilitate a right-wing government, while Vox in Spain and AfD in Germany push high-visibility campaigns to leverage strong polling numbers.

countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson drops SD's cabinet seat demand, altering coalition dynamics to enable a right-leaning government under Kristersson.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal calls for a major national mobilization ahead of the upcoming 29N elections.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Surging in state polls, AfD demands the dissolution of the Thuringia state parliament to force immediate elections.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen and Bardella intensify attacks on left-wing platforms to solidify RN's position as the primary opposition for 2027.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Conservative and far-right leaders continue engaging in cross-border visits and parallel diplomatic endeavors to strengthen their political standing. Argentine President Javier Milei conducted meetings with Spanish right-wing leaders in Madrid, while exiled Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro built ties with Trump figures at Mar-a-Lago.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing nationalist parties are heightening demands for strict immigration enforcement, remigration concepts, and national preference policies. Prominent figures across Spain, the US, Italy, and France are advancing hardline rhetoric to energize their core electoral bases.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen accuses political opponents of orchestrating a 'dismantling of France' while advocating strict national sovereignty.
